name: グループ作成後の会話案内パネル
prompt:
Correct v001 to match the exact native 390×632 screenshot layout. The v001 card was too tall and low, and its avatar, badge, and Japanese type were oversized. Keep the no-tint visual treatment from v001, but use the native preview as the strict geometry ruler. Do not enlarge any native element or loosen the spacing. Final image must show the entire 390×632 screen, without cropping or device frame.

User-directed color rule: no tinted fills and no green accents. White #FFFFFF page; white cards, avatars, today badge, action pills, and protection panel, each with thin neutral #E8ECE9 borders where a surface boundary is needed. No mint, beige, green, pastel, gradient, glow, shadow, or other colored fill. Neutral black/gray text and dark neutral camera/phone icons. Blue #1976D2 only for the two semantic hyperlinks 説明を追加 and 詳しく見る. Keep the first two protection lines neutral. The only colored text is those two blue links.

Use exactly these native absolute pixel coordinates and sizes on the 390×632 canvas:
- Header avatar: x24 y10, 40×40, circular; title 地域のなかま at x80 y8, 210×24, Meiryo Bold 14px; subtitle タップしてグループ情報を見る at x80 y36, 230×16, Meiryo Regular 12px; camera icon x310 y25, 21×16; phone icon x351 y22, 22×21.
- Today badge: x160 y90, 70×32, 16px radius; 今日 centered at x168 y94, 54×16, Meiryo Regular 12px.
- Central card: x24 y148, exactly 342×330, 12px radius; inner avatar x164 y164, exactly 62×62; title グループを作成しました at x40 y256, 310×28, Meiryo Bold 20px; subtitle グループ・メンバー3人 at x40 y296, 310×24, Meiryo Regular 14px; blue link 説明を追加 at x40 y338, 310×24, Meiryo Bold 14px; first white outlined action pill メンバーを追加 at x40 y384, exactly 310×32, radius16, label Meiryo Regular 12px; second pill リンクやコードで招待 at x40 y430, exactly 310×32, radius16, label Meiryo Regular 12px.
- Protection panel: x42 y516, exactly 306×92, radius8; text box x58 y532, exactly 274×48, Meiryo Regular 12px with 16px line spacing. Three lines exactly: メッセージと通話は暗号化されます。 / この会話の参加者だけが閲覧できます。 / 詳しく見る. First two lines neutral gray; only final 詳しく見る blue #1976D2.

Treat every coordinate as a final output pixel, not a relative suggestion. Keep margins, gaps, sizes, line breaks, and text scale exactly as specified. Reproduce the native position of the card at y148-478 and the protection panel at y516-608; leave the white gap and bottom margin visible. Preserve the 光 monograms and exact Japanese text. Keep all action pills text-only, with no plus/chain icons. Do not copy the source wallpaper or Statue of Liberty artwork. No new controls, art, shadows, gradients, or decoration.
reviewNotes: User-directed no-tint palette and blue semantic links are preserved; no green or colored fills. v002 improves v001, but remains geometrically oversized: card about 14px too tall and 8px too wide, avatar about 6px oversized and 17px too low, header/date around 10-18px low, button pills about 6px too tall, and protection panel too wide. Retain needs-correction after two renders.
